MaterialSelection Provide a selection of faces that use the specified material
MergeByDistance Merge vertices or points within a given distance

ScaleElements Scale groups of connected edges and faces

SetCurveNormal Set the evaluation mode for curve normals

SetCurveTilt Set the tilt angle at each curve control point
SetFaceSet Set sculpt face set values for faces

SetGeometryName Set the name of a geometry for easier debugging
SetGreasePencilColor Set color and opacity attributes on Grease Pencil geometry

SetGreasePencilSoftness Set softness attribute on Grease Pencil geometry

Arc

Arc(
    resolution=16,
    start=(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    middle=(0.0, 2.0, 0.0),
    end=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    radius=1.0,
    start_angle=0.0,
    sweep_angle=7 * math.pi / 4,
    offset_angle=0.0,
    connect_center=False,
    invert_arc=False,
    *,
    mode='RADIUS',
)

Generate a poly spline arc

Parameters

Name Type Description Default
resolution InputInteger Resolution 16
start InputVector Start (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
middle InputVector Middle (0.0, 2.0, 0.0)
end InputVector End (1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
radius InputFloat Radius 1.0
start_angle InputFloat Start Angle 0.0
sweep_angle InputFloat Sweep Angle 7 * math.pi / 4
offset_angle InputFloat Offset Angle 0.0
connect_center InputBoolean Connect Center False
invert_arc InputBoolean Invert Arc False

Create Arc with operation ‘Points’. Define arc by 3 points on circle. Arc is calculated between start and end points

props
props(
    label=None,
    color=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    hide=None,
    show_options=None,
    hide_inputs=(),
    hide_outputs=(),
    mute=None,
    warning_propagation=None,
    pin_gizmo=None,
    pin_gizmo_inputs=(),
)

Set the properties every node has and return the node, so it can go at the end of a chain::

g.SetPosition(geometry=geo, offset=offset).props(
    label="Lift", color="#FFAA00", width=200
)

Properties left as None are unchanged.

Args: label: The node’s header label. color: A custom header colour, as a hex string ("#FFAA00") or an (r, g, b) tuple; turns on use_custom_color. width: The node’s width. height: The node’s height; only frames use it. hide: Collapse the node. show_options: Show the node’s options (dropdowns and toggles). hide_inputs: Input sockets to hide, by name; "Value#1" names the second visible Value. hide_outputs: Output sockets to hide, by name. mute: Mute (bypass) the node. warning_propagation: Which of the node’s warnings show on the group node it sits in. pin_gizmo: Keep the node’s gizmo visible when it isn’t selected: a gizmo node’s, or a value node’s (Value, Vector, …). pin_gizmo_inputs: Inputs whose gizmos stay visible when the node isn’t selected, by name; for group nodes passing a gizmo through.

radius
radius(
    resolution=16,
    radius=1.0,
    start_angle=0.0,
    sweep_angle=7 * math.pi / 4,
    connect_center=False,
    invert_arc=False,
)

Create Arc with operation ‘Radius’. Define radius with a float

props
props(
    label=None,
    color=None,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    hide=None,
    show_options=None,
    hide_inputs=(),
    hide_outputs=(),
    mute=None,
    warning_propagation=None,
    pin_gizmo=None,
    pin_gizmo_inputs=(),
)

Set the properties every node has and return the node, so it can go at the end of a chain::

g.SetPosition(geometry=geo, offset=offset).props(
    label="Lift", color="#FFAA00", width=200
)

Properties left as None are unchanged.

Args: label: The node’s header label. color: A custom header colour, as a hex string ("#FFAA00") or an (r, g, b) tuple; turns on use_custom_color. width: The node’s width. height: The node’s height; only frames use it. hide: Collapse the node. show_options: Show the node’s options (dropdowns and toggles). hide_inputs: Input sockets to hide, by name; "Value#1" names the second visible Value. hide_outputs: Output sockets to hide, by name. mute: Mute (bypass) the node. warning_propagation: Which of the node’s warnings show on the group node it sits in. pin_gizmo: Keep the node’s gizmo visible when it isn’t selected: a gizmo node’s, or a value node’s (Value, Vector, …). pin_gizmo_inputs: Inputs whose gizmos stay visible when the node isn’t selected, by name; for group nodes passing a gizmo through.

Inputs

Attribute Type Description
i.geometry GeometrySocket Geometry
i.remove BooleanSocket Remove

Outputs

Attribute Type Description
o.geometry GeometrySocket Geometry
o.bundle BundleSocket Bundle
